name: Schrodinger equation
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="4">

    <description>
        The <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Schr%C3%B6dinger_equation">Schrödinger equation</a> describes the change in the 
        wave function for some quantum state. For a travelling particle, the magnitude of the wave packet describes the probability the that particle 
        will be found at each location.

        Here a wave packet travels through empty space. Over time the probability spreads out, because of uncertainty in its initial momentum.
        
        In our implementation, 'a' represents the real part of the complex number and 'b' the imaginary part. 
        The magnitude is shown in 'c' but doesn't affect the system.
        
        Derivation:
        
        <tt>
        i*(dx/dt) = -Laplacian(x)
        </tt>
        
        where x is a complex number a+bi, i is the square root of -1.
        
        hence:
        <tt><pre>da/dt = -Im(Laplacian(x)) = -Laplacian(b)
        db/dt =  Re(Laplacian(x)) =  Laplacian(a)</pre></tt>
    </description>

    <rule type="formula" name="Schrodinger equation">
        
      <param name="timestep">    0.001    </param>

      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
        delta_a = -laplacian_b;
        delta_b =  laplacian_a;
        c = hypot( a, b );
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
    
    <initial_pattern_generator apply_when_loading="true">
        
      <overlay chemical="c">
        <overwrite />
        <gaussian height="1" sigma="0.03">
          <point3D x="0.2" y="0.3" z="0.5" />
        </gaussian>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>

      <overlay chemical="a">
        <overwrite />
        <sine amplitude="1" phase="0">
          <point3D x="0" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3D x="0.03" y="0" z="0" />
        </sine>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="a"><multiply /><other_chemical chemical="c" /><everywhere /></overlay>
      
      <overlay chemical="b">
        <overwrite />
        <sine amplitude="1" phase="1.5708">
          <point3D x="0" y="0" z="0" />
          <point3D x="0.03" y="0" z="0" />
        </sine>
        <everywhere />
      </overlay>
      <overlay chemical="b"><multiply /><other_chemical chemical="c" /><everywhere /></overlay>
      
    </initial_pattern_generator>
    
    <render_settings>
       <active_chemical value="c" />
       <show_displacement_mapped_surface value="true" />
       <color_displacement_mapped_surface value="false" />
       <low value="-1" />
       <high value="1" />
       <vertical_scale_1D value="100" />
       <vertical_scale_2D value="100" />
       <timesteps_per_render value="1024" />
    </render_settings>
    
  </RD>
  <ImageData WholeExtent="0 511 0 0 0 0"></ImageData>
</VTKFile>
